parent.status: GPT FAIL; preserved unchanged as diagnostic checkpoint

build_rule: r99 is built from a copy of the r98 file; r98 is never written. All r98 content (r97 AC-joint scapula pivot, glenohumeral half-swing helpers, r98 rest-slit shape and weights) is preserved except the declared fold-band weight transfer.

new_bones.anterior: axfold_ant_<s>: parent spine_03, head at the pectoral fold origin on the anterior chest wall, tail at the pectoralis-major humeral insertion; STRETCH_TO the insertion target (child of upperarm_<s>, lateral lip of the bicipital groove level).
new_bones.posterior: axfold_post_<s>: parent scapula_<s>, head near the scapular inferior-angle/latissimus fold origin, tail at the latissimus/teres-major humeral insertion; STRETCH_TO the insertion target (child of upperarm_<s>).
new_bones.runtime_rule: fold bone world matrix = origin frame from parent, Y axis aimed at the insertion target, Y scaled to the current origin-insertion distance (Blender STRETCH_TO, no volume compensation unless declared in the receipt)

weights.rule: local, smooth, mirror-symmetric transfer onto the fold bones within a band around each origin-insertion segment on the fold surface; transferred share taken proportionally from the vertex's existing declared-bone weights only; non-declared bone weights unchanged exactly; at most 4 influences

scope.narrow_exceptions: a change to r97/r98 mechanics or rest shape requires measured evidence and a separate amendment committed before the change

measurements: kinematics of fold bones through abduction/flexion 0-170 deg and axial internal/neutral/external (length, direction continuity, no flip)

acceptance_targets.no_regression_vs_r98: repo pose test self-intersections on press_top, press_top_rhythm, press_bottom, squat_bottom, pullup_hang, pullup_hang_rhythm, pullup_top (tolerance 0 above r98, report any change)
acceptance_targets.stretch_compression: no worsening of overhead stretched/compressed edge counts vs r98
acceptance_targets.visual: membrane, rear-deltoid dent and back creases must visibly improve in front/axilla/rear close-ups; failure to improve is reported, not hidden
